agenda_items.title: Notices and meeting information for meeting participants and the public
agenda_items.description:
Members of Committee and Council, City staff, media and the general public may join the meeting with this link:
Zoom meeting no. 879 8714 9068
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and remote participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
The deadline to register to speak, or submit written comments is 4 pm on the day of the meeting.

sub_agendas_items.title: Traffic and Parking By-law Amendments : Accessible Parking
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Megan Richards, Program Manager of the Accessibility Office provided a presentation and answered questions from the Committee. As well, Phil Edens, Senior Traffic Assessment Specialist, Traffic Services and Scott Caldwell, Manager, Parking Services both from the Public Works Department were available to answer questions.A copy of the slide presentation is filed with the Office of the City Clerk. 
One delegate, Kyle Humphrey spoke before the Committee and provided comments on how this will provide more space for those needing it and this will allow people to more easily shop and fraternize as they will be able to access more areas.
